metadata.title: adaQuest L1 SOC Triage - MVP deployment
metadata.description: Deploys the automatic launcher, Sentinel incident actions, and Microsoft Teams notification Logic Apps.
Name of the Logic App that applies the triage result to the Sentinel incident.
Name of the Logic App that starts the Security Copilot agent for new incidents.
Name of the Logic App that sends closed and escalated incident notifications to Microsoft Teams.
Azure region for the actions Logic App and its API connections.
Azure region for the launcher Logic App and its API connections. Security Copilot connector availability can vary by region.
Subscription ID that contains the Microsoft Sentinel workspace.
Resource group that contains the Microsoft Sentinel workspace.
Log Analytics workspace with Microsoft Sentinel enabled.
Security Copilot Agent Execution ID (GUID) used by the launcher to execute the installed agent. This is not the Microsoft Entra Agent ID/Blueprint identity.
Security Copilot agent trigger name.
Optional Microsoft Entra UPN assigned as owner when an incident is escalated. Leave empty to preserve the current owner.
Microsoft Teams Team ID for automatically closed incident notifications.
Microsoft Teams Channel ID for automatically closed incident notifications.
Microsoft Teams Team ID for L2/L3 escalation notifications.
Microsoft Teams Channel ID for L2/L3 escalation notifications.
Delay before the agent starts, allowing the Unified XDR incident to synchronize.
Display name of the Microsoft Sentinel automation rule.
Enable the automation rule immediately after deployment.
Execution order of the automation rule.
Optional Object ID of the Microsoft Sentinel Automation service principal. When supplied, the template grants Microsoft Sentinel Automation Contributor on the playbook resource group.
Tags applied to all deployed resources.

IncidentId.description: Unified XDR incident ID supplied to the agent

Comment.description: Complete and unmodified L1 SOC triage report

EscalationAssigneeUPN.description: Optional tenant-configured Microsoft Entra UPN used only for escalation assignment

inputs.body:
let InputXdrIncidentId = tostring('@{triggerBody()?['IncidentId']}');
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| where ProviderName in~ ("Microsoft XDR", "Microsoft 365 Defender")
| where tostring(ProviderIncidentId) == InputXdrIncidentId
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentName
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 1
| project
    IncidentNumber,
    ProviderIncidentId,
    ProviderName,
    IncidentName,
    Title,
    Status,
    Severity

ReturnCommentSuccess.inputs: @concat('SUCCESS | Comment added to Microsoft Sentinel incident ', triggerBody()?['IncidentId'], ' | Incident ARM ID: ', outputs('BuildIncidentArmId'))

ReturnCommentFailure.inputs: @concat('FAILED | Microsoft Sentinel incident ', triggerBody()?['IncidentId'], ' was found, but the comment could not be added. Do not report success. Review the Logic App run history for the connector error.')

DecisionValuesValid.inputs:
@and(
  contains(createArray('True Positive', 'Benign Positive', 'False Positive', 'Undetermined'), triggerBody()?['Verdict']),
  contains(createArray('High', 'Medium', 'Low'), triggerBody()?['Confidence']),
  contains(createArray('Close', 'Remediate', 'Escalate'), triggerBody()?['RecommendedAction']),
  contains(createArray('FalsePositive', 'BenignPositive', 'None'), triggerBody()?['Classification']),
  contains(createArray('IncorrectAlertLogic', 'InaccurateData', 'SuspiciousButExpected', 'None'), triggerBody()?['ClassificationReason']),
  contains(createArray('Yes', 'No'), triggerBody()?['InvestigationComplete']),
  contains(createArray('Yes', 'No'), triggerBody()?['HasCriticalGaps']),
  contains(createArray('Yes', 'No'), triggerBody()?['RequiresContainmentOrRemediation']),
  contains(createArray('Yes', 'No'), triggerBody()?['HasSensitiveDataRisk']),
  contains(createArray('Yes', 'No'), triggerBody()?['HasPrivilegedIdentityRisk']),
  contains(createArray('Yes', 'No'), triggerBody()?['HasConfirmedMaliciousIndicators']),
  contains(createArray('Yes', 'No'), triggerBody()?['AutoCloseEligible']),
  contains(
    createArray(
      'adaQuest-AutoClosed',
      'adaQuest-Escalation',
      'adaQuest-RemediationRequired',
      'adaQuest-ReviewRequired'
    ),
    triggerBody()?['OutcomeTag']
  ),
  greater(length(trim(string(triggerBody()?['DecisionReasoning']))), 0),
  lessOrEquals(length(string(triggerBody()?['DecisionReasoning'])), 1000)
)

SafeAutoClose.inputs:
@and(
  equals(triggerBody()?['AutoCloseEligible'], 'Yes'),
  equals(triggerBody()?['Confidence'], 'High'),
  equals(triggerBody()?['RecommendedAction'], 'Close'),
  equals(triggerBody()?['InvestigationComplete'], 'Yes'),
  equals(triggerBody()?['HasCriticalGaps'], 'No'),
  equals(triggerBody()?['RequiresContainmentOrRemediation'], 'No'),
  equals(triggerBody()?['HasSensitiveDataRisk'], 'No'),
  equals(triggerBody()?['HasPrivilegedIdentityRisk'], 'No'),
  equals(triggerBody()?['HasConfirmedMaliciousIndicators'], 'No'),
  or(
    equals(outputs('IncidentRecord')?['Status'], 'new'),
    equals(outputs('IncidentRecord')?['Status'], 'active')
  ),
  greater(length(trim(string(triggerBody()?['DecisionReasoning']))), 0),
  lessOrEquals(length(string(triggerBody()?['DecisionReasoning'])), 1000),
  or(
    and(
      equals(triggerBody()?['Verdict'], 'False Positive'),
      equals(triggerBody()?['Classification'], 'FalsePositive'),
      or(
        equals(triggerBody()?['ClassificationReason'], 'IncorrectAlertLogic'),
        equals(triggerBody()?['ClassificationReason'], 'InaccurateData')
      )
    ),
    and(
      equals(triggerBody()?['Verdict'], 'Benign Positive'),
      equals(triggerBody()?['Classification'], 'BenignPositive'),
      equals(triggerBody()?['ClassificationReason'], 'SuspiciousButExpected')
    )
  )
)

classification.ClassificationReasonText:
@concat(
  'Closed automatically by adaQuest L1 SOC Triage Agent. Verdict: ',
  triggerBody()?['Verdict'],
  '. Classification reason: ',
  triggerBody()?['ClassificationReason'],
  '. Decision reasoning: ',
  triggerBody()?['DecisionReasoning']
)

runError.message: The investigation comment was added and escalation updates were attempted, but the final Sentinel status, tags, or owner preservation could not be verified. Review the Logic App run history.
The incident comment and escalation tags were added and the incident was activated, but the configured escalation assignee UPN is invalid. No owner was assigned.

ReturnIncidentNotFound.inputs: @concat('NOT_FOUND | Microsoft Sentinel incident ', triggerBody()?['IncidentId'], ' was not found in the configured workspace within the 90-day search window. No comment was added.')

runError.message: NotificationType must be AutoClosed or Escalated.
The Sentinel incident trigger did not provide providerIncidentId or incidentNumber. The Security Copilot agent was not executed.

automationRuleResourceId.value: [concat('/subscriptions/', parameters('sentinelSubscriptionId'), '/resourceGroups/', parameters('sentinelResourceGroupName'), '/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/', parameters('sentinelWorkspaceName'), '/providers/Microsoft.SecurityInsights/AutomationRules/', guid(parameters('sentinelSubscriptionId'), parameters('sentinelResourceGroupName'), parameters('sentinelWorkspaceName'), parameters('launcherLogicAppName'), 'incident-created'))]
